title: WPC Smart Messages for WooCommerce plugin before 4.3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows…
description: The WPC Smart Messages for WooCommerce plugin versions before 4.3.6 have a missing authorization vulnerability. Authenticated users with Contributor or Author roles can exploit this flaw by using specially crafted shortcodes to access arbitrary post meta and private product data without proper capability checks. This allows exposure of sensitive customer and business information such as billing emails, phone numbers, addresses, private product descriptions, and purchase notes to unauthenticated visitors.
